component.name: Deck Patcher
component.summary: Community patch manager for Steam Deck

description.p: Deck Patcher is a GUI application for the Steam Deck that lets you browse, apply, and revert community-maintained patches for games and apps.
Patches can fix compatibility issues, enable features not available by default, or set up non-Steam apps with proper Steam library entries, artwork, and launch options.
All patches are reversible and backed up automatically before any changes are made. The app monitors applied patches and alerts you when a system update reverts them.
Initial release — patch browser, apply/revert, multi-account support, auto-reapply watcher, and SteamGridDB artwork picker.
